accepted_scope: For every d >= 1 and every globally L-Lipschitz B on Euclidean R^d, the quadratic-cost Brenier map from standard Gaussian to normalized exp(-B) Gaussian has a globally Lipschitz representative bounded by C(0,L), independent of d. Original target follows with B=-f.

Scalar constant optimization and quadratic logarithmic growth
